book.name: Mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ
book.title: Ŋwa wu mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ Joŋ le

content: Ntuŋ wu Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Saldi le
Muh wù ŋgɛ̀ n'yɛŋ wɛɛ ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Saldi le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛmɛ wù wuwɛɛ wù kɛme biyo bi Nyo bì bvusooshwi mo jóŋ yì bvusooshwi: Ŋkee gee chena. Bɛŋ duunyi fɛ bamii le lɛ bɛŋ baaŋ ba wuŋ geenɛ bɛŋ nyume bɛŋ kweeyɛ wa.
Bɛŋ kâŋsɛ, bɛŋ tâa bvuŋga yi fiɛɛ fì shɛshi wa tɛ jwe wu kwe le. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ mbaaŋ n'yɛŋ gɛ gee chena joŋe chi gɛɛne chi mɛɛse a Nyo waŋ jii gɛ.
Bɛŋ kwâjɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ gɛ̀ fi, le fi fì bɛŋ gɛ̀ yu. Bɛŋ jîji fiɛɛ fiyu le, bɛŋ kûsɛ muntele mwɛna. Nɛ bɛŋ baaŋ kaŋsɛ gɛ, tu nlé ŋgê njâ ntô fɛ bɛŋ le njɛ choŋ, bɛŋ kee gɛ kife kiyu gɛ.
Geenɛ, bɛŋ kɛme bamii bamu shige Saldi bo baaŋ yiisɛ gɛ njú yiboo gɛ. Bobaa lé bo gê bo jîɛnyi besa bo, bo noŋ njú yì baaŋ, nje le bamii ba kooji.

Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô lé wu jîi tɛ njú yì baaŋ. Gɛ wuwɛɛ muh mɛ nyume ŋgê nchîijɛ jee che a ŋwa wù bamii ba kɛme kinche kì kage gɛ le. Nlé ŋgê njɛ̂mɛ bɛ jwe waŋ kune wu fwe a Chii bɛ banchɛndaa be lɛ ŋkee wu.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le.’”

content: Ntuŋ wu Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Filadɛfia le
Muh wuyu ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Filadɛfia le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛmɛ wù wuwɛɛ wù yuude wù ka nyu muh wù nchiɛɛŋ. Le wu wù kɛme kiŋgwenyɛ ki bvunfoŋ bvu Dabi lɛ. Wu gwenyi, muh gɛ nyu yu wù faa gɛ, wu faa, muh gɛ nyu yu wù gwenyɛ gɛ:

Ŋkee gee chena. Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, nle ŋgwenyɛ kimbuŋ fɛ bɛŋ le nchinɛ kiyɛse, gɛ muh nyu yu wù taŋlo wu faa ki gɛ. Ŋkee lo lɛ gɛ bɛŋ kɛme bvuŋga chuule gɛ, geenɛ bɛŋ gɛɛde gɛ njɛmɛ waŋ. Bɛŋ baaŋ mɛ faŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bamii baa ba le ŋgoo yi Sataŋ le bò duu lɛ bo le Bajuu bo mbiane lo, bo nyu gɛ Bajuu gɛ, nlé ŋgê bo tô bo gwê bikaa biɛna le bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ lɛ ŋkoŋe bɛŋ.
No bɛŋ le bɛŋ gɛɛ njɛme waŋ kune ki bɛŋ kâane shɛ́ŋ, nlé ŋgê nchîɛɛŋ bɛŋ yi kife kì mmoŋ lé wu gê wu tôo yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le ki wu môŋ bamii bachii ba le yi nshɛŋ le.
Ntoo wa kife kì shige le. Bɛŋ jîjɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ kɛme le fi tɛ̂mɛ, wu lɛ keefɛ muh mu ge wu fî kifo kena ki bvunfoŋ gɛ.

Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô, nlé ŋgê wu nyû kintooŋ ki yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo waŋ le. Gɛ taŋlo wu yu wu bû yu gɛ. Nlé ŋgê nsâŋ jee chi Nyo waŋ yi ye ye le bɛ jee chi kilaantɛŋ ki Nyo waŋ kì le Yɛlusalɛm wù fwɛŋ wù bude fɛ Nyo waŋ le fɛwe. Nlé ŋgê nsâŋ tɛ jee chaŋ chì fɛŋ yi ye ye le.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le.’”

content: Ntuŋ wu Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Lawdɛsia le
Wu ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Lawdɛsia le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛme wù wuwɛɛ wù jee che le lɛ, Fi Nyûme Noo. Le wuwɛɛ wù to wu lɛme yi jɛ ye le, le wu wù sɛŋe nchiɛɛŋ kune Nyo. Le wu wù ŋkɛ yi fiɛɛ fichii fì Nyo gɛ̀ fɛ le:
Ŋkee gee chena. Bɛŋ le gɛh lo nɛ! Gɛ bɛŋ jiɛɛ gɛ, gɛ bɛŋ yufe gɛ. Ŋgoone lɛ bɛŋ bee bɛŋ jiɛɛ lo kɛnɛ bɛŋ yufe lo.
Noo, no bɛŋ le gɛh lo fiena antɛnɛɛ bɛŋ jiɛɛ gɛ kɛnɛ bɛŋ yufe gɛ, nlé ŋgê nchûuyɛ bɛŋ a mɛ mu.

Bɛŋ duu lɛ bɛŋ le bamii ba kwa bɛŋ ku wa, bɛŋ ka goone gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ. Bɛŋ jɛme noo bɛŋ yɛne gɛ lɛ fiena le fi fo lo gɛ? Bɛŋ le bamii ba ba koode yii fɛ bɛŋ le, bɛŋ nyu bamii ba kifufe, bɛŋ ka nyume binfeeŋ mo bamii ba jiɛnyi bichinɛ biyɛse.

Ŋgoone ki nteefɛ bɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ gû kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde kì ba suŋ fɛ kilamɛ le ki tu ki yuude, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ nyu bamii ba kwa. Bɛŋ gû njú yì baaŋ yì bɛŋ baŋe bichinɛ biɛna yu, keefɛ bamii yɛde bi le bɛŋ kɛme bvuya gɛ. Bɛŋ gû tɛ nche yi ajii a mɛne yì bɛŋ yêefe ajii awene yu, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ yɛ̂de mwɛɛ le.
Bamii ba ŋkoŋe nto nsage bo yi gee chiboo le, nnya ŋgɛ bo le ki ntêefe bo. Noo, bɛŋ dûnyɛ ntaŋ, bɛŋ kûsɛ muntele mwɛna.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, nlɛme a yeh fwɛɛŋ ŋkune. Nɛ muh yu lo jɛ yaŋ wu gwênyɛ kimbuŋ, nlé ntô a wu le besa wu lé be gê be jîi mwɛɛ yi fiɛɛ le fimimia.
Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô, le mɛ nyu ŋgê nnyâ wu kijusɛ wu shii besa wu yi kala waŋ le, gɛh no ŋgɛ̀ nso nshii besa Chii yi kala we le.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le.’”
